facts.source_prose:
Fleeca Heist Finale — 2x GTA$ — First completion of the Fleeca Heist Finale pays double GTA$ through August 5. Setup missions for Fleeca also pay more than usual, but the article does not state the exact increase.
Pacific Standard Heist Finale — 2x GTA$ — First completion of the Pacific Standard Heist Finale pays double GTA$ through August 5. Setup missions for Pacific Standard also pay more than usual, but the article does not state the exact increase.
Motor Wars — 2x GTA$ and RP — Motor Wars pays double GTA$ and RP through August 5.
Shipwrecks on Cayo Perico — 2x GTA$ and RP — Shipwrecks on Cayo Perico pay double GTA$ and RP through August 5.
A Kick in the Wallet mission series — 3x GTA$ and RP — The community mission series by II_TREIZIEME_II pays triple GTA$ and RP through August 5.
A Superyacht Life missions — 2x GTA$ and RP — A Superyacht Life missions pay double GTA$ and RP through August 12.
Kortz Center Heist rotating art lineup — This week's art lineup features pieces from S.P. Carroll, Francesco Zozzone, and Mina Major. Selling your first Primary Target of the week comes with a bonus payout on top of the usual haul.
GTA+ Shark Cards — 15% bonus cash — GTA+ members get access to Shark Cards with 15% bonus cash.
Galaxy Super Yacht and modifications — 60% off — The Galaxy Super Yacht and all of its modifications are discounted.
Paleto Bay business properties — 60% off
Karin Kuruma — 60% off — Applies to both armored and standard Karin Kuruma models.
High End Apartments — 40% off
Benny's conversion upgrades — 40% off
Invetero Coquette D1 — 30% off — Part of the select car discounts listed in the article.
Imponte Ruiner ZZ-8 — 30% off — Part of the select car discounts listed in the article.
Dinka Blista Kanjo — 30% off — Part of the select car discounts listed in the article.
Other select cars — 30% off — The article mentions additional select cars but does not name them.
Hao's Special Works conversions — 50% off for GTA+ members — GTA+ members receive 50% off HSW conversions.
Art Studio upgrade for the Kortz Center Heist — GTA$1,000,000 off for GTA+ members — GTA+ members receive a GTA$1,000,000 discount on the Mansion Art Studio upgrade used for the Kortz Center Heist.
